information: **New Participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DurgeshaOpen2017#3164-registration-payment) tab. **Returning participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions. Step 2 - Register for the competition. Step 3 - Pay according to the procedure mentioned in the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DurgeshaOpen2017#3164-registration-payment) tab. ***Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment.*** **For more details on the registration process please check the [registrations&payments](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DurgeshaOpen2017#3164-registration-payment) tab. For the competition Schedule please check the [schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DurgeshaOpen2017#3163-schedule).**
